subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: The exact dollar figure that determines whether an agency must issue a formal competitive solicitation (like an IFB/RFP) rather than gathering informal quotes is established by:
options: The Federal Government for all local agencies
State statute or local governmental ordinances/charters
questions.explain: Formal competition thresholds are strictly a matter of statutory law, defined by state legislation or local municipal codes/charters.
